denominators: All hours include the first 72 observed hours; forecast hours/days exclude that history.
line_ids: 1-based original MATPOWER branch row; endpoints use original bus IDs

profile_diagnostic.model: L2 logistic C=1, standardized max realized daily ref_t only
profile_diagnostic.interpretation: Oracle structural diagnostic: realized next-day profile is forbidden as a forecasting input; does not establish S forecast calibration.

calibration_figures.rule: Exclude voltage components over95% in train or calibration forecast hours; also require5positive/5negative distinct calibration days; no test-based selection.
